Dear [Mr Craik](../persons.html#379)
I am very happy to accept your offer of [£25 ](../others.html#160)for the Australian edition of [Chantry House](../books.html#186).
I wish I could disinter A Citizen’s account of the Bristol riots of 1832.[^1] It is referred to in the Life of Bishop Gray and said to be excellent; but I could not get it from the [London Library](../others.html#29), and I wish I could see it before the proofs of that Chapter of Chantry House are irrevocable.

Yours very truly

C M Yonge

[^1]: Perhaps John Eagles, The Bristol riots, their causes, progress, and consequences.

By a citizen (Bristol, Gutch and Martin 1832).
